name: PR#8428 (CBRD-27961) pt_fold_union () -- the node that takes the place of a folded set operation (the remaining arm, the derived table made around it, or the NULL value) takes the set operation's sql_user_text and sql_user_text_len with its line, column, alias and next; a set operation that is a subquery keeps the text its arms already carry; the derived table gets the set operation's ORDER BY, LIMIT and rewrite flag; nothing to fold returns the node as is; a derived table that cannot be made returns NULL with the parser error
